notes: Eligible with a stated AUD price: Y wait (food_truck; $15/$49/$89 a month per venue incl. GST + an unstated platform fee per order), Bopple (nearest_local; $49/month excl. tax + 1.64% + $0.10 per order) and Square (pos; $0 / $129 a month, 2.2% online card fee). Eligible food-truck tools without a price: Asky (Brisbane; 'Ask for Pricing', monthly fee + commission, setup usually $299 currently waived), Qhop (festival/stall order-and-pay, no pricing page) and Wollopit (custom-build agency, quoted per job — reviewer may prefer not_relevant). HungryHungry and Order Up! are eligible restaurant tools with hidden prices. Liven's business side has moved to Nomni (liven.love/industries/food-trucks 308-redirects to nomni.ai; Order Up! also says 'Nomni is the new home of Order Up!'); Nomni's food-truck page is POS-led with no order-ahead wording and no price. Ordering.co: no AUD price, no AU presence, and today's pricing page shows no amounts (stored 99 USD not seen). Flash Order (US) and RapidOrderz have no AU presence on their own sites. Bopple's pricing page has an AUD/NZD/USD toggle; the $49 was read as shown and the AUD platform fee is explicit on /pricing/fees. Quotes were extracted through a page-reading tool; a few were capped near 125 chars by the tool. Square AU pages are script-heavy: /au/en/online-ordering returned only its title.
